views.name: bowler_scores_enriched
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  bs.MatchID AS MatchID,
  bs.GameNumber AS GameNumber,
  bs.BowlerID AS BowlerID,
  bs.RawScore AS RawScore,
  bs.HandiCapScore AS HandiCapScore,
  bs.WonGame AS WonGame,
  b.BowlerLastName AS BowlerLastName,
  b.BowlerFirstName AS BowlerFirstName,
  b.BowlerMiddleInit AS BowlerMiddleInit,
  b.TeamID AS TeamID,
  t.TeamName AS TeamName,
  tm.TourneyID AS TourneyID,
  tn.TourneyDate AS TourneyDate,
  tn.TourneyLocation AS TourneyLocation,
  tm.Lanes AS Lanes,
  mg.WinningTeamID AS WinningTeamID
FROM Bowler_Scores AS bs
LEFT JOIN Bowlers AS b
  ON bs.BowlerID = b.BowlerID
LEFT JOIN Teams AS t
  ON b.TeamID = t.TeamID
LEFT JOIN Match_Games AS mg
  ON bs.MatchID = mg.MatchID
  AND bs.GameNumber = mg.GameNumber
LEFT JOIN Tourney_Matches AS tm
  ON bs.MatchID = tm.MatchID
LEFT JOIN Tournaments AS tn
  ON tm.TourneyID = tn.TourneyID

semantic_filters.none: no forced filters; use downstream WHERE to limit by date/team/bowler/etc.

params.description: Enriched per-bowler, per-match-game scores and context (player, team, match, and tournament attributes) at the grain of MatchID + GameNumber + BowlerID.
params.when_to_use: Retrieve every bowler's score and match-level context for a specific match, game, or tournament date range. | Compute per-game counts, averages, or rates per bowler by aggregating RawScore or HandiCapScore across this view's rows. | Join to ranking/aggregation views (e.g., bowler_season_stats_from_bowlers) using the same grain keys to build higher-level summaries without re-hydrating base tables. | Produce match-game level reports that show who won the game (WonGame) and the team that won the match game (WinningTeamID) alongside bowler-level scores.
params.output_schema: MatchID: match identifier for the game; derived from Bowler_Scores.MatchID (bs.MatchID) | GameNumber: sequential game number within the match; derived from Bowler_Scores.GameNumber (bs.GameNumber) | BowlerID: unique bowler identifier; derived from Bowler_Scores.BowlerID (bs.BowlerID) | RawScore: raw numeric score the bowler posted in this game; derived from Bowler_Scores.RawScore (bs.RawScore) | HandiCapScore: handicap-adjusted score for this bowler game; derived from Bowler_Scores.HandiCapScore (bs.HandiCapScore) | WonGame: boolean/flag indicating whether this bowler is marked as having won this game (per row); derived from Bowler_Scores.WonGame (bs.WonGame) | BowlerLastName: bowler's last name from the Bowlers dimension; derived from Bowlers.BowlerLastName (b.BowlerLastName) | BowlerFirstName: bowler's first name from the Bowlers dimension; derived from Bowlers.BowlerFirstName (b.BowlerFirstName) | BowlerMiddleInit: bowler's middle initial from the Bowlers dimension; derived from Bowlers.BowlerMiddleInit (b.BowlerMiddleInit) | TeamID: team identifier the bowler belongs to (may be NULL if no team row); derived from Bowlers.TeamID (b.TeamID) | TeamName: team display name from Teams; derived from Teams.TeamName (t.TeamName) | TourneyID: tournament identifier for the match (if the match is part of a tournament); derived from Tourney_Matches.TourneyID (tm.TourneyID) | TourneyDate: tournament date from Tournaments; derived from Tournaments.TourneyDate (tn.TourneyDate) | TourneyLocation: tournament location from Tournaments; derived from Tournaments.TourneyLocation (tn.TourneyLocation) | Lanes: lane count or lane identifier held on Tourney_Matches for this match; derived from Tourney_Matches.Lanes (tm.Lanes) | WinningTeamID: the team that won this particular match game (from Match_Games); derived from Match_Games.WinningTeamID (mg.WinningTeamID)
params.grounded_columns: Bowler_Scores.MatchID | Bowler_Scores.GameNumber | Bowler_Scores.BowlerID | Bowler_Scores.RawScore | Bowler_Scores.HandiCapScore | Bowler_Scores.WonGame | Bowlers.BowlerLastName | Bowlers.BowlerFirstName | Bowlers.BowlerMiddleInit | Bowlers.TeamID | Teams.TeamName | Match_Games.MatchID | Match_Games.GameNumber | Match_Games.WinningTeamID | Tourney_Matches.MatchID | Tourney_Matches.TourneyID | Tourney_Matches.Lanes | Tournaments.TourneyID | Tournaments.TourneyDate | Tournaments.TourneyLocation
params.metric: RawScore = direct base column (Bowler_Scores.RawScore). Not an aggregate in this view. | HandiCapScore = direct base column (Bowler_Scores.HandiCapScore). Not an aggregate in this view. | WonGame = direct base column flag (Bowler_Scores.WonGame). Not an aggregate in this view. | WinningTeamID = direct base column from Match_Games.WinningTeamID joined at (MatchID, GameNumber). Not an aggregate in this view.
params.composition: cardinality-SAFE join guidance: join to Teams on TeamID (this view contains TeamID from Bowlers as a 1:1 or many-to-1 key to Teams) — safe because Teams is a dimension keyed by Teams.TeamID and joining to it will not duplicate this view's rows when TeamID is unique in Teams. | cardinality-SAFE join guidance: join to Tournaments on TourneyID (this view exposes TourneyID via Tourney_Matches) — safe when Tournaments.TourneyID is unique (dimension); joining will not duplicate rows. | cardinality-SAFE join guidance: join to Bowlers on BowlerID is unnecessary here because this view already includes selected Bowlers columns. If needed, joining to a fuller Bowlers dimension on BowlerID is safe only if Bowlers has one row per BowlerID (which the base join in this view assumes). | do NOT blindly join to one-to-many tables (examples: any table that stores multiple events per MatchID or per BowlerID such as a hypothetical Bowler_Notes with multiple note rows per BowlerID, or a Shots table with multiple shot rows per bowler-game) without aggregation first — those joins will multiply rows and thus multiply RawScore/HandiCapScore measures unless you re-aggregate or deduplicate. Specifically, do NOT join to any table that has multiple rows per (MatchID, GameNumber, BowlerID) without first reducing that table to a single row per that grain. | safe composition with sibling aggregated views: join this view to aggregated views that are keyed at the same or coarser grain (for example bowler_season_stats_from_bowlers keyed by BowlerID and season) only when you join on the matching key(s) and treat aggregated metrics appropriately (aggregates from the sibling view are already reduced and will not be duplicated). | when composing upward (aggregating this view): to compute measures like total RawScore per Bowler in a tournament, aggregate RawScore across rows grouped by the desired key(s) of this view (e.g., group by BowlerID, TourneyID) rather than joining to additional detail tables. | joining to Match_Games or Tourney_Matches is already represented in this view via WinningTeamID and Lanes; do not re-join to those base tables on MatchID(+GameNumber) unless you need additional columns not present here. If you do re-join, join on (MatchID, GameNumber) to preserve 1:1 correspondence and avoid duplication because Match_Games is expected to have 1 row per (MatchID, GameNumber).

views.description: Denormalized per-bowler-per-game scores joined to bowler, match, team and tournament context. Use this when you need bowler-level results with identifying attributes (bowler name, team, match lanes, tournament date/location) for aggregations, filters, or downstream ranking. | Use for: List scores and handicaps for bowlers in a given tournament/date/team/match; Compute per-bowler aggregates (avg score, total pins) within tournaments or across season; Find which bowlers won games and which team won the game

views.name: bowler_season_stats_from_bowlers
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  BowlerID AS BowlerID,
  BowlerLastName AS BowlerLastName,
  BowlerFirstName AS BowlerFirstName,
  BowlerMiddleInit AS BowlerMiddleInit,
  TeamID AS TeamID,
  BowlerTotalPins AS BowlerTotalPins,
  BowlerGamesBowled AS BowlerGamesBowled,
  BowlerCurrentAverage AS BowlerCurrentAverage,
  BowlerCurrentHcp AS BowlerCurrentHcp
FROM Bowlers

semantic_filters.none: no forced filters; this is the current-state per-bowler summary

params.description: Per-bowler season summary (one row per BowlerID) containing identifying fields, team membership, and season-level totals/metrics (total pins, games bowled, current average, current handicap).
params.when_to_use: Fetch a bowler's season totals or current average/handicap for display (profiles, roster pages). | Filter or group by bowler when composing higher-level aggregates (team totals, tournament leaderboards) while preserving one-row-per-bowler semantics. | Join to dimension/lookups (team, personal details) to enrich bowler-season rows without changing aggregated measures. | Start point for computing per-team or per-division aggregates by re-aggregating the BowlerTotalPins / BowlerGamesBowled across BowlerID.
params.output_schema: BowlerID: Unique identifier for the bowler — derived from Bowlers.BowlerID. | BowlerLastName: Bowler's last name — derived from Bowlers.BowlerLastName. | BowlerFirstName: Bowler's first name — derived from Bowlers.BowlerFirstName. | BowlerMiddleInit: Bowler's middle initial — derived from Bowlers.BowlerMiddleInit. | TeamID: Identifier of the team that the bowler belongs to — derived from Bowlers.TeamID. | BowlerTotalPins: Season total pins for this bowler — derived from Bowlers.BowlerTotalPins (stored aggregate/metric). | BowlerGamesBowled: Season total games bowled for this bowler — derived from Bowlers.BowlerGamesBowled (stored aggregate/metric). | BowlerCurrentAverage: Bowler's current average (season/tracking) — derived from Bowlers.BowlerCurrentAverage (stored metric). | BowlerCurrentHcp: Bowler's current handicap — derived from Bowlers.BowlerCurrentHcp (stored metric).
params.grounded_columns: Bowlers.BowlerID | Bowlers.BowlerLastName | Bowlers.BowlerFirstName | Bowlers.BowlerMiddleInit | Bowlers.TeamID | Bowlers.BowlerTotalPins | Bowlers.BowlerGamesBowled | Bowlers.BowlerCurrentAverage | Bowlers.BowlerCurrentHcp
params.metric: BowlerTotalPins = Bowlers.BowlerTotalPins (pre-computed/stored season total pins; treated as a measure at BowlerID grain). | BowlerGamesBowled = Bowlers.BowlerGamesBowled (pre-computed/stored season games count; measure at BowlerID grain). | BowlerCurrentAverage = Bowlers.BowlerCurrentAverage (stored metric at BowlerID grain, typically BowlerTotalPins / BowlerGamesBowled or an external calculation but used as provided). | BowlerCurrentHcp = Bowlers.BowlerCurrentHcp (stored metric at BowlerID grain).
params.composition: cardinality-SAFE join guidance: join to team_match_results on TeamID — safe because this view is one-row-per BowlerID and team_match_results should be aggregated by TeamID if you want to combine team-level measures; however joining directly team_match_results (one row per TeamID) to this view will duplicate team metrics across bowlers if team metrics are not at BowlerID grain. To preserve correctness, either aggregate team_match_results to BowlerID (e.g., distribute/allocate) or join for dimension attributes only (team name) and do not sum team metrics without re-aggregation. | cardinality-SAFE join guidance: join to zip_lookup_for_bowlers (JOIN) on BowlerID if that view is one-row-per-BowlerID — safe because keys match one-to-one and will not duplicate measures. | cardinality-SAFE join guidance: join to bowler_scores_enriched (JOIN) only when you intend to expand per-bowler rows into per-score/per-game rows — this is a one-to-many join and will duplicate BowlerTotalPins/BowlerGamesBowled per score row. If composing to compute new aggregates from scores, re-aggregate scores and then join (or aggregate after the join and divide out duplication). | cardinality-SAFE join guidance: join to bowler_game_rank_within_match (RANK) carefully — it is typically one-to-many (multiple games/ranks per bowler). Do not directly sum BowlerTotalPins after joining without re-aggregation, because measures in this view are already at BowlerID grain and would be multiplied by the number of rank rows per bowler. | cardinality-SAFE join guidance: join to bowler_running_totals_in_tourney (WIN) only if that view is one-row-per-BowlerID (check its grain). If it is per-bowler-per-tournament or per-window it is one-to-many and will duplicate measures; instead aggregate running totals to BowlerID before joining or join only for non-measure attributes. | general rule: this view is strictly one-row-per BowlerID (BowlerID grain). Any join to a table/view that is many-rows-per-BowlerID will multiply the Bowler* measures. To preserve correct results when composing metrics, either (a) join only to dimension-style single-row-per-key tables/views, (b) pre-aggregate the many-side to BowlerID before joining, or (c) perform joins then re-aggregate and compute measures at the desired grain (do not rely on BowlerTotalPins being additive across duplicated rows without accounting for duplication).

views.description: Precomputed aggregate career/current statistics per bowler from the Bowler-level summary columns. Useful as a canonical per-bowler metrics table for joining to other relations or ranking bowlers by performance. | Use for: Rank bowlers by current average or total pins; Join per-bowler current stats to recent tournament performance; Filter bowlers by team and compute roster-level aggregates

views.name: team_match_results
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  tm.MatchID AS MatchID,
  tm.TourneyID AS TourneyID,
  tm.Lanes AS Lanes,
  tm.OddLaneTeamID AS OddLaneTeamID,
  tm.EvenLaneTeamID AS EvenLaneTeamID,
  mg.GameNumber AS GameNumber,
  mg.WinningTeamID AS WinningTeamID,
  CASE WHEN tm.OddLaneTeamID = mg.WinningTeamID THEN tm.OddLaneTeamID
       WHEN tm.EvenLaneTeamID = mg.WinningTeamID THEN tm.EvenLaneTeamID
       ELSE NULL END AS WinningTeamInMatch,
  -- expose per-game boolean flags for odd/even team win
  CASE WHEN tm.OddLaneTeamID = mg.WinningTeamID THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS OddLaneWonFlag,
  CASE WHEN tm.EvenLaneTeamID = mg.WinningTeamID THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS EvenLaneWonFlag
FROM Tourney_Matches AS tm
JOIN Match_Games AS mg
  ON tm.MatchID = mg.MatchID

semantic_filters.none: no forced filters; keep all matches/games

params.description: Per-match, per-game results for the two teams (odd/even lanes) in a match: which team won each game and boolean flags for odd/even lane wins.
params.when_to_use: Report the winner of each game in a match (by MatchID and GameNumber). | Compose match-level or tourney-level aggregates of game wins by team (e.g., games won per team in a match or tournament) when starting from per-game results. | Filter or join game-level winners to player- or team-level stats when you need game granularity (not per-bowler granularity). | Identify which lane-side (odd vs even) won each game for lane-based analyses.
params.output_schema: MatchID: unique match identifier from Tourney_Matches.MatchID (base table column). | TourneyID: tournament identifier from Tourney_Matches.TourneyID (base table column). | Lanes: lane configuration info from Tourney_Matches.Lanes (base table column). | OddLaneTeamID: team id assigned to odd-numbered lanes from Tourney_Matches.OddLaneTeamID (base table column). | EvenLaneTeamID: team id assigned to even-numbered lanes from Tourney_Matches.EvenLaneTeamID (base table column). | GameNumber: game sequence number within the match from Match_Games.GameNumber (base table column). | WinningTeamID: team id recorded as winning that game from Match_Games.WinningTeamID (base table column). | WinningTeamInMatch: the WinningTeamID only if it matches one of the two match teams (OddLaneTeamID or EvenLaneTeamID); derived as CASE expression over Tourney_Matches.OddLaneTeamID, Tourney_Matches.EvenLaneTeamID and Match_Games.WinningTeamID. | OddLaneWonFlag: integer flag (1/0) indicating whether the odd-lane team won this game; derived as (CASE WHEN Tourney_Matches.OddLaneTeamID = Match_Games.WinningTeamID THEN 1 ELSE 0 END). | EvenLaneWonFlag: integer flag (1/0) indicating whether the even-lane team won this game; derived as (CASE WHEN Tourney_Matches.EvenLaneTeamID = Match_Games.WinningTeamID THEN 1 ELSE 0 END).
params.grounded_columns: Tourney_Matches.MatchID | Tourney_Matches.TourneyID | Tourney_Matches.Lanes | Tourney_Matches.OddLaneTeamID | Tourney_Matches.EvenLaneTeamID | Match_Games.MatchID | Match_Games.GameNumber | Match_Games.WinningTeamID
params.metric: WinningTeamInMatch = CASE WHEN Tourney_Matches.OddLaneTeamID = Match_Games.WinningTeamID THEN Tourney_Matches.OddLaneTeamID WHEN Tourney_Matches.EvenLaneTeamID = Match_Games.WinningTeamID THEN Tourney_Matches.EvenLaneTeamID ELSE NULL END | OddLaneWonFlag = CASE WHEN Tourney_Matches.OddLaneTeamID = Match_Games.WinningTeamID THEN 1 ELSE 0 END | EvenLaneWonFlag = CASE WHEN Tourney_Matches.EvenLaneTeamID = Match_Games.WinningTeamID THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
params.composition: Safe: join to a match-level dimension (e.g., Tourney_Matches) on MatchID — safe because this view is already one row per MatchID+GameNumber+team_role (the view's grain is MatchID + GameNumber + team_role), and Tourney_Matches is one-row-per-MatchID; joining on MatchID will not duplicate game-level rows. | Safe: aggregate this view (GROUP BY MatchID, WinningTeamID or TeamID) before joining to team-level summaries to compute games-won-per-team — do aggregation on this view to produce one-row-per-team before joining to avoid duplication. | Do NOT join this view directly to a one-to-many child of Match_Games (for example a per-bowler-per-game scores table) without first aggregating or deduplicating, because those joins will multiply game rows and therefore duplicate the view's per-game measures (OddLaneWonFlag/EvenLaneWonFlag). | Do NOT join to a many-to-many table keyed only by TeamID (e.g., a roster table with multiple bowlers per team) without aggregating the view to the same team granularity first; otherwise flags/counts will be multiplied. | When composing into higher-level metrics (e.g., total games won per team in a tournament): SELECT TourneyID, WinningTeamInMatch AS TeamID, SUM(OddLaneWonFlag + EvenLaneWonFlag) AS GamesWon FROM team_match_results GROUP BY TourneyID, WinningTeamInMatch — this pattern is cardinality-safe because it aggregates the view's per-game rows before joining to other dimensions. | If you need to join to bowler-level views (bowler_scores_enriched, bowler_game_rank_within_match, bowler_running_totals_in_tourney), first decide the target grain: either (a) aggregate bowler-level tables up to MatchID+GameNumber or TeamID+MatchID+GameNumber to align with this view, or (b) aggregate this view up to TeamID+MatchID before joining. Failing to align grain will multiply measures.

views.description: Team-level results per match aggregated from Match_Games and Tourney_Matches. Produces one row per match-team combination showing whether the team was odd/even lane, whether they won each game, and tournament context. Useful for team standings, match-level win/loss summaries, and joining to team rosters. | Use for: Compute team match wins across a tournament or season; Identify which lane (odd/even) tends to win more games; Join to Teams to produce standings or captain-level reports

views.name: bowler_game_rank_within_match
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  bs.MatchID AS MatchID,
  bs.GameNumber AS GameNumber,
  bs.BowlerID AS BowlerID,
  bs.RawScore AS RawScore,
  bs.HandiCapScore AS HandiCapScore,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY bs.MatchID, bs.GameNumber ORDER BY bs.RawScore DESC) AS RawScoreRank,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY bs.MatchID, bs.GameNumber ORDER BY bs.HandiCapScore DESC) AS HandiCapRank
FROM Bowler_Scores AS bs

semantic_filters.none: no forced filters; downstream queries can filter RawScoreRank <= k or HandiCapRank <= k

params.description: Ranks bowlers within each match and game by raw score and handicap score, returning one row per (MatchID, GameNumber, BowlerID) with both scores and their ranks.
params.when_to_use: Find the placement/ranking of a bowler within a specific match and game (e.g., who was 1st/2nd by raw score or handicap). | Compare raw vs handicap rank for a bowler in a given match+game. | Compose match-level or bowler-level summaries that need each bowler's per-game rank as input (for example: counting number of game wins in a match or season). | Join to bowler or match dimensions to produce human-readable leaderboards (name, team, venue) while preserving per-game ranks. | Filter or aggregate ranked results (e.g., count bowlers with RawScoreRank = 1 per match) — safe when aggregating back to the intended grain.
params.output_schema: MatchID: identifier of the match that contains the game — derived from Bowler_Scores.MatchID. | GameNumber: the number/index of the game within the match — derived from Bowler_Scores.GameNumber. | BowlerID: identifier of the bowler who produced the score — derived from Bowler_Scores.BowlerID. | RawScore: the bowler's unadjusted score for the game — derived from Bowler_Scores.RawScore. | HandiCapScore: the bowler's handicap-adjusted score for the game — derived from Bowler_Scores.HandiCapScore. | RawScoreRank: rank (RANK(), ties receive same rank and gaps may occur) of RawScore within the partition (MatchID, GameNumber) ordered DESC — computed from RawScore via window function. | HandiCapRank: rank (RANK(), ties receive same rank and gaps may occur) of HandiCapScore within the partition (MatchID, GameNumber) ordered DESC — computed from HandiCapScore via window function.
params.metric: RawScore = Bowler_Scores.RawScore | HandiCapScore = Bowler_Scores.HandiCapScore | RawScoreRank = RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY Bowler_Scores.MatchID, Bowler_Scores.GameNumber ORDER BY Bowler_Scores.RawScore DESC) | HandiCapRank = RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY Bowler_Scores.MatchID, Bowler_Scores.GameNumber ORDER BY Bowler_Scores.HandiCapScore DESC)
params.composition: cardinality-SAFE join guidance: join to bowler_scores_enriched ON (MatchID, GameNumber, BowlerID) — safe because this view is one-row-per (MatchID, GameNumber, BowlerID) (the same grain as Bowler_Scores) so joining additional 1:1 or 1:0-1 enrichment columns will not duplicate ranks or scores. | cardinality-SAFE join guidance: join to a bowler dimension (e.g., a Bowler master table keyed by BowlerID) ON (BowlerID) — safe because dimension is one-row-per BowlerID; it will not multiply this view's rows. | cardinality-SAFE join guidance: join to a match dimension (e.g., Match table keyed by MatchID) ON (MatchID) — safe because match dimension is one-row-per MatchID; it will not multiply this view's rows. | NOT safe without re-aggregation: do NOT directly join to team_match_results (an aggregate per team/match) on MatchID or other keys expecting 1:1 — if team_match_results is one-row-per team per match, joining it could multiply this view's rows when multiple teams exist per match. If you need team-level metrics combined with these ranks, either aggregate this view up to match+team grain or aggregate team_match_results to the same grain before joining. | NOT safe without re-aggregation: do NOT join directly to bowler_season_stats_from_bowlers (an aggregate per bowler or per bowler+season) unless its grain is compatible (e.g., BowlerID and Season) — joining a lower-grain aggregate (many seasons or many rows per BowlerID) can multiply rows. Instead, pre-aggregate or filter the sibling view to one-row-per BowlerID (or per BowlerID+Season that matches this view's context) before joining. | NOT safe without re-aggregation: do NOT join directly to bowler_running_totals_in_tourney (a windowed/running-total view) if it returns multiple rows per (MatchID, GameNumber, BowlerID) for different partitions or windows; ensure the running totals view is reduced to one-row-per (MatchID, GameNumber, BowlerID) or appropriate grain first. | JOIN planning note: Because RawScoreRank and HandiCapRank are produced by RANK() partitioned by (MatchID, GameNumber), any join that introduces duplicate rows per (MatchID, GameNumber, BowlerID) will invalidate 'one rank per bowler per game' semantics and will duplicate these measures. When composing, ensure the downstream planner either preserves the view's grain (one row per MatchID+GameNumber+BowlerID) or re-aggregates after joining to a one-to-many table. | COMPOSITION PATTERN: To build match-level summaries (e.g., number of game wins per match), aggregate this view: COUNTIF(RawScoreRank = 1) GROUP BY MatchID, GameNumber or further GROUP BY MatchID as needed — this avoids any join duplication issues. | COMPOSITION PATTERN: To attach season or team attributes from sibling aggregates, first reduce those aggregates to one-row-per relevant key that matches this view's grain (e.g., one-row-per BowlerID) or add them via LEFT JOIN after ensuring they are 1:1 to BowlerID/MatchID.

views.description: Ranks bowlers within each match and game by RawScore and by HandiCapScore (dense rank). Useful for answering top-k questions per game or producing medalists for each game/match while preserving ties. | Use for: Return top N bowlers by raw or handicap score per game/match; Identify ties and rankings within a match/game

views.name: bowler_running_totals_in_tourney
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  be.BowlerID AS BowlerID,
  be.TourneyID AS TourneyID,
  be.MatchID AS MatchID,
  be.GameNumber AS GameNumber,
  be.RawScore AS RawScore,
  be.HandiCapScore AS HandiCapScore,
  SUM(be.RawScore) OVER (PARTITION BY be.TourneyID, be.BowlerID ORDER BY be.MatchID, be.GameNumber ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS CumulativeRawScore,
  SUM(be.HandiCapScore) OVER (PARTITION BY be.TourneyID, be.BowlerID ORDER BY be.MatchID, be.GameNumber ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS CumulativeHandiCapScore
FROM (
  SELECT
    bs.MatchID AS MatchID,
    bs.GameNumber AS GameNumber,
    bs.BowlerID AS BowlerID,
    bs.RawScore AS RawScore,
    bs.HandiCapScore AS HandiCapScore,
    tm.TourneyID AS TourneyID
  FROM Bowler_Scores AS bs
  LEFT JOIN Tourney_Matches AS tm
    ON bs.MatchID = tm.MatchID
) AS be

semantic_filters.none: no forced filters; TourneyID may be NULL for scores not linked to a tournament

params.description: Provides per-bowler, per-tournament running totals of raw and handicapped scores ordered by match and game (cumulative scores up through each game).
params.when_to_use: Show a bowler's cumulative raw and handicapped score progression within a tournament (up to a specific match/game). | Build leaderboards or time-series of cumulative scoring for bowlers inside a tournament. | Compose match- or tournament-level aggregates that use cumulative values (but ensuring correct aggregation semantics). | Join to bowler, match or tournament dimensions to add descriptive attributes while preserving cumulative measures.
params.output_schema: BowlerID: identifier for the bowler (derived from Bowler_Scores.BowlerID) | TourneyID: identifier for the tournament the match belongs to (derived from Tourney_Matches.TourneyID via join in the view's FROM subquery) | MatchID: identifier for the match containing this game (derived from Bowler_Scores.MatchID) | GameNumber: ordinal number of the game in the match (derived from Bowler_Scores.GameNumber) | RawScore: the raw score for this bowler in this match/game (derived from Bowler_Scores.RawScore) | HandiCapScore: the handicapped score for this bowler in this match/game (derived from Bowler_Scores.HandiCapScore) | CumulativeRawScore: running sum of RawScore partitioned by TourneyID and BowlerID ordered by MatchID, GameNumber (defined in this view using window SUM over referenced columns) | CumulativeHandiCapScore: running sum of HandiCapScore partitioned by TourneyID and BowlerID ordered by MatchID, GameNumber (defined in this view using window SUM over referenced columns)
params.grounded_columns: Bowler_Scores.MatchID | Bowler_Scores.GameNumber | Bowler_Scores.BowlerID | Bowler_Scores.RawScore | Bowler_Scores.HandiCapScore | Tourney_Matches.MatchID | Tourney_Matches.TourneyID
params.metric: CumulativeRawScore = SUM(Bowler_Scores.RawScore) OVER (PARTITION BY Tourney_Matches.TourneyID, Bowler_Scores.BowlerID ORDER BY Bowler_Scores.MatchID, Bowler_Scores.GameNumber ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) | CumulativeHandiCapScore = SUM(Bowler_Scores.HandiCapScore) OVER (PARTITION BY Tourney_Matches.TourneyID, Bowler_Scores.BowlerID ORDER BY Bowler_Scores.MatchID, Bowler_Scores.GameNumber ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) | RawScore (base measure) = Bowler_Scores.RawScore | HandiCapScore (base measure) = Bowler_Scores.HandiCapScore
params.composition: cardinality-SAFE join guidance: join to a bowler dimension (e.g., Bowler table or bowler-specific view) on BowlerID — safe because bowler dimension is one-row-per-BowlerID so it will not duplicate this view's rows or multiply cumulative measures. | cardinality-SAFE join guidance: join to a tournament/match dimension (e.g., Tourney or Tourney_Matches as a dimension) on TourneyID or MatchID — safe when those dimension tables are one-row-per-TourneyID or one-row-per-MatchID respectively, they will not duplicate rows. | cardinality-SAFE join guidance: join to bowler_scores_enriched (JOIN sibling) only if you join on the identical grain (MatchID, GameNumber, BowlerID, TourneyID) — if bowler_scores_enriched is one-row-per-game per-bowler it will align 1:1 and be safe. | do NOT join without aggregation to one-to-many tables/views from this view such as bowler_season_stats_from_bowlers (AGG) or team_match_results (AGG) if those produce multiple rows per (TourneyID,BowlerID,MatchID,GameNumber) because they can multiply rows and thereby incorrectly duplicate cumulative measures; instead either: | - re-aggregate the joined table to the view's grain (TourneyID, BowlerID, MatchID, GameNumber) before joining, or | - join at a higher grain (for example, join aggregated results at TourneyID+BowlerID or MatchID level) and then recompute metrics as appropriate. | do NOT join to rank-like siblings (e.g., bowler_game_rank_within_match) if that view returns multiple rank rows per (MatchID,GameNumber) across bowlers unless joining on BowlerID+MatchID+GameNumber to preserve 1:1 mapping; if rank view is one-row-per-(MatchID,GameNumber,BowlerID) that join is safe; otherwise aggregate or filter to one row per game before joining. | When composing further aggregations: to compute tournament-level totals or averages from this view, aggregate the underlying base measures (RawScore, HandiCapScore) at the desired grain instead of summing the running totals directly — running totals are cumulative and summing them across games will produce inflated results. Prefer aggregating RawScore and HandiCapScore then computing desired aggregates (e.g., SUM(RawScore) for total tournament raw). | Ordering sensitivity: cumulative metrics depend on ordering by MatchID, GameNumber. Ensure any additional joins or filters do not change the logical ordering (for example, do not replace ordering with a non-deterministic field) when relying on CumulativeRawScore/CumulativeHandiCapScore semantics.

views.description: Running totals of RawScore and HandiCapScore per bowler within a tournament ordered by MatchID and GameNumber. Produces one row per bowler-game with cumulative pins; useful for tracking cumulative scoring across a tournament for leaderboards or momentum analysis. | Use for: Show running totals per bowler across a tournament; Produce leaderboards at each round of a tournament

views.name: zip_lookup_for_bowlers
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.BowlerID AS BowlerID,
  b.BowlerLastName AS BowlerLastName,
  b.BowlerFirstName AS BowlerFirstName,
  b.BowlerCity AS BowlerCity,
  b.BowlerState AS BowlerState,
  b.BowlerZip AS BowlerZip,
  wz.City AS City,
  wz.State AS State
FROM Bowlers AS b
LEFT JOIN WAZips AS wz
  ON b.BowlerZip = wz.ZIP

semantic_filters.none: no forced filters; join is left so bowlers without WA ZIP still appear

params.description: Provides one-row-per-bowler contact and ZIP-based city/state lookup by joining Bowlers to the WAZips reference table.
params.when_to_use: Look up a bowler's city/state based on their stored BowlerZip and include bowler name/contact fields. | Enrich bowler-level reports with ZIP-derived City/State for display or grouping (one row per BowlerID). | Compose into higher-level analyses that need bowler-level attributes (e.g., join bowler attributes onto aggregated bowler metrics).
params.output_schema: BowlerID: unique identifier for the bowler (derived from Bowlers.BowlerID) | BowlerLastName: bowler's last name (derived from Bowlers.BowlerLastName) | BowlerFirstName: bowler's first name (derived from Bowlers.BowlerFirstName) | BowlerCity: city stored on the Bowlers table for the bowler (derived from Bowlers.BowlerCity) | BowlerState: state stored on the Bowlers table for the bowler (derived from Bowlers.BowlerState) | BowlerZip: ZIP code stored on the Bowlers table for the bowler (derived from Bowlers.BowlerZip) | City: city name looked up from WAZips by matching BowlerZip to WAZips.ZIP (derived from WAZips.City) | State: state abbreviation looked up from WAZips by matching BowlerZip to WAZips.ZIP (derived from WAZips.State)
params.grounded_columns: Bowlers.BowlerID | Bowlers.BowlerLastName | Bowlers.BowlerFirstName | Bowlers.BowlerCity | Bowlers.BowlerState | Bowlers.BowlerZip | WAZips.ZIP | WAZips.City | WAZips.State
params.metric: This view exposes no aggregated metrics; all output columns are row-level attributes copied or looked up from base tables. | There are no derived aggregate expressions in this view.
params.composition: cardinality-SAFE join guidance: join to dimension or lookup-level views/tables that are one-row-per-bowler (or keyed by BowlerID) on BowlerID — safe because zip_lookup_for_bowlers is one-row-per-BowlerID so joining on BowlerID will not duplicate rows or multiply measures. | Safe: join to bowler_scores_enriched on BowlerID if bowler_scores_enriched is at the same grain (one row per BowlerID) or has been pre-aggregated to BowlerID — safe because keys align one-to-one. | Safe: join to bowler_season_stats_from_bowlers only if that view is aggregated to BowlerID (one row per BowlerID). If bowler_season_stats_from_bowlers is aggregated by BowlerID+Season, first aggregate or filter to BowlerID-level before joining to avoid row multiplication. | Unsafe without re-aggregation: do NOT directly join zip_lookup_for_bowlers to one-to-many child tables or views (for example raw game/match-level scoring tables, team_match_results if at match level, bowler_game_rank_within_match if at per-game/per-match rank grain, or bowler_running_totals_in_tourney if at per-game/window grain) on BowlerID without first aggregating those child tables to BowlerID-level. Such joins would duplicate the one-row-per-bowler rows and thus multiply any measures derived from this view (though this view has no aggregates itself, downstream planners must avoid accidental multiplication). | If you need to combine with one-to-many data (games, matches, per-game ranks): either (a) aggregate the one-to-many data to BowlerID before joining, or (b) join and then re-aggregate to the desired grain, ensuring you do not SUM or COUNT the copied attribute columns expecting them to remain row-level identifiers. | When composing additional measures: treat columns from this view as attributes (dimensions). Any metric aggregation must be computed from the original many-side data or from correctly aggregated sibling views to preserve correct cardinality.

views.description: Maps bowlers' BowlerZip to WA city/state using WAZips. Useful to enrich bowler addresses with canonical city/state and to group/filter bowlers by region. | Use for: Group bowlers by city/state for regional reports; Validate or enrich bowler address data using ZIP table

views.name: bowler_score_wins
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  bs.MatchID,
  bs.GameNumber,
  bs.BowlerID,
  bs.RawScore,
  bs.HandiCapScore,
  bs.WonGame
FROM Bowler_Scores AS bs

semantic_filters.none: no intrinsic filters; expose all rows (filtering applied in question_ops)

views.description: One row per bowler game score with win flag and raw & handicap scores. Useful as a base cohort of game results restricted to winning games or any score-based filters.

views.name: tourney_match_context
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  TM.MatchID AS MatchID,
  TM.TourneyID AS TourneyID,
  T.TourneyDate AS TourneyDate,
  T.TourneyLocation AS TourneyLocation,
  TM.Lanes AS Lanes,
  TM.OddLaneTeamID AS OddLaneTeamID,
  TM.EvenLaneTeamID AS EvenLaneTeamID
FROM Tourney_Matches AS TM
JOIN Tournaments AS T
  ON TM.TourneyID = T.TourneyID

semantic_filters.none: no intrinsic filters; include all current (non-archive) matches and their tournaments

views.description: Denormalized mapping from a match to its tournament and participating teams/lanes. Exposes tournament id, date, and location for matches to join game rows to venue/date.

views.name: bowlers_core
views.body_sql:
